payload.title: Allow deterministic tool-only procedures to run without agents
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want deterministic portfolio procedures that invoke only trusted tools to execute without a synthetic language-model agent, so that read-only ranking and reporting can start safely and predictably.

Out of scope: changing optimizer approval gates, adding model work, or changing score data.

Feature: Tool-only procedure compatibility

Scenario: Run a valid deterministic procedure with no agents
Given a valid Tactus procedure declares no agents and its code uses only registered deterministic tools
When the procedure is executed through the Plexus procedure runtime
Then configuration validation accepts the procedure
And execution reaches the procedure code
And no synthetic agent or model call is required

Scenario: Reject an agent reference without an agent definition
Given a procedure declares no agents
And its code references an agent primitive
When the procedure is validated
Then validation fails with an actionable missing-agent error
